correctness.rationale: For n>=2, removing two occurrences yields zero sum iff their pair sum is T. At T=0 avoidance forces distinct values, counted by standard character orthogonality. At fixed nonzero T, complementary coset exclusivity and odd/even occupancy give U_m/m projection-zero configurations; subtract all-even V_m and divide by two via toggling an odd endpoint, obtaining (U_m-mV_m)/N. The n=8 rank-three inverse argument exhausts all odd support patterns and affine 4-point bases. The packaged integer-only checker confirms specified finite cases and is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact avoidance count of zero-sum subsequences of a length tied to total sequence length is a natural inverse refinement of the generalized EGZ forcing invariant. The displayed formula determines an entire infinite rank-by-length distribution, not an arbitrary isolated invariant. In the first rank-three extremal case it gives every avoiding sequence and its affine orbit, refining mere sharpness of the bound.
